headline: 6 Common Heat Pump Myths, Debunked
subheading: Heat pumps don't work in the cold, they're noisy, they're bad for the environment: we hear these all the time. Here's what's true, what used to be true, and what never was.
seoTitle: 6 Common Heat Pump Myths, Debunked | Heat Pump Guides
description: Do heat pumps work in cold weather? Are they noisy? Are they really greener on a fossil fuel grid? Six common heat pump myths, and what the facts say.
